acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

title:
Type used to enable acl authorization on a given type. The type that will be acl enabled just needs to mixin
AclEnabled. Details on acl usage can be found at {@link access-control.c3doc Data Access using Acl}

When mixing in this type, along with Configurable and/or Versionable, Configurable should be mixed in first,
followed by this AclEnabled then Versionable (as appropriate).
name: AclEnabled
